allow: PowerShell(Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; $r = Invoke-WebRequest http://localhost:5173/ -UseBasicParsing; "status: $\($r.StatusCode\)"; $p = Invoke-RestMethod http://localhost:5173/api/vegetables/; "proxy api ok: $\($p.vegetables.Count\) veggies")

PowerShell(Start-Sleep 3; $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Method Post http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/chatbot/ -ContentType "application/json" -Body '{"message":"how to make palak paneer?"}'; $r.reply; "recipe: $\($r.recipe.name\), veggies: $\($r.recipe.veggies.Count\), steps: $\($r.recipe.steps.Count\), pantry: $\($r.recipe.pantry.Count\)"; $r.recipe.veggies | ForEach-Object { "$\($_.product.name\) [$\($_.weight\)] available=$\($_.available\)" })
